search_bias: evaluation/verifiers; adaptive reused-dev validity; information leakage; anytime-valid paired acceptance; cumulative false-commit risk

public_sources.title: PACE: Anytime-Valid Acceptance Tests for Self-Evolving Agents
public_sources.used_scope: PACE evaluates incumbent/candidate on a small reused development set with a paired sign e-process. Its theorem is per candidate and assumes the conditional candidate-only win probability is at most 1/2 under the null. The paper explicitly does not claim run-level familywise control and treats loop-level adaptive reuse empirically rather than as a proved reusable-holdout guarantee.

public_sources.title: SGM: A Statistical Gödel Machine for Risk-Controlled Recursive Self-Modification
public_sources.used_scope: Supplies multi-round risk budgeting/union-bound style protection, but its guarantees rely on bounded i.i.d. paired differences and a stable evaluation harness. Used to separate cumulative multiplicity control from per-candidate data-validity assumptions.

public_sources.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
public_sources.authors: Cynthia Dwork; Vitaly Feldman; Moritz Hardt; Toniann Pitassi; Omer Reingold; Aaron Roth
public_sources.used_scope: Repeated adaptive reuse of a holdout invalidates ordinary independence-based holdout reasoning unless information leakage is controlled; reusable-holdout/privacy/max-information techniques provide a different path to validity.

public_sources.title: What Fits (Into Few Tokens) Doesn't Overfit: Compression and Generalization in ML Research Agents
public_sources.authors: Martin Bertran; Aaron Roth; Zhiwei Steven Wu
public_sources.used_scope: Formal adaptive-validation guarantees through a pre-specified low-information transcript. The one-bit ladder yields simultaneous description-length generalization bounds; all validation-dependent side channels must be included. Reported T=50, K=7, n=5000 examples have roughly 2.4 to 4.7 percentage-point Hoeffding-style widths, with KL tightening in some regimes.

public_sources.title: Self-Evolving Agents with Anytime-Valid Certificates
public_sources.used_scope: Explicitly highlights the endogenous-loop failure mode when the policy produces the data/evaluator/hypothesis space and reserves a held-out grader for terminal measurement. Used as corroboration for separating search signals from final measurement, not as proof of arbitrary reused-dev validity.

public_sources.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses via Gated Semantic Quality-Diversity
public_sources.used_scope: Practical self-evolution separates train-time gated decisions from a sealed test scored after evolution; reported retained train gains on sealed test. Used only as an empirical design pattern, not as a theorem about reusable dev-set e-values.

adaptive_reuse_counterexample.setup: Let the deployment distribution be nonatomic. Let the reused finite dev set D contain at least eight points where incumbent h0 fails. After D has already steered candidate generation, construct h_D to be identical to h0 everywhere except that it memorizes/corrects exactly those eight dev points.
adaptive_reuse_counterexample.population_effect: Exactly zero under the nonatomic population because the candidate differs from the incumbent only on finitely many measure-zero points.
adaptive_reuse_counterexample.reused_dev_result: The eight selected discordances are all candidate-only wins, so default PACE wealth is 1.5^8 = 25.62890625 > 20 even though population improvement is zero.
adaptive_reuse_counterexample.why_theorem_does_not_apply: This is not a failure of optional-stopping mathematics. Adaptive candidate construction from D violates the within-candidate conditional sign-null assumption Pr(candidate-only win | discordant, past) <= 1/2.
adaptive_reuse_counterexample.fresh_audit_contrast: Freeze h_D, then draw a fresh audit sample independent of D. In the nonatomic construction it almost surely contains none of the finitely memorized points, so the selected dev-only advantage does not reproduce.
adaptive_reuse_counterexample.scope: Worker-local existence proof demonstrating possibility, not a claim that typical self-evolving agents realize this extremal attack.

sufficient_conditional_null_condition.statement: For round r, freeze candidate C_r before audit observations. Let G_r contain all past proposal/search history. If the new audit stream is conditionally fresh/independent of G_r (or otherwise has a separately proved sequential conditional-null property), and the null implies Pr(candidate-only win | discordant, within-round past, G_r) <= 1/2, then predictable paired sign e-factors remain valid even when C_r was generated adaptively from earlier data.
sufficient_conditional_null_condition.failure_mode: Reusing a dev set that already influenced C_r generally destroys this sufficient condition unless a distinct stability/information-leakage theorem controls the dependence.

two_axis_validity.axis_1_data_adaptivity: Is the candidate-level evidence process valid after accounting for the information about evaluation data that entered candidate generation?
two_axis_validity.axis_2_multiplicity: Given valid candidate-level tests, is cumulative false-commit risk across repeated candidate rounds bounded?
two_axis_validity.non_substitution: Global alpha/error spending addresses axis 2 only. It cannot repair an invalid candidate-level test on axis 1.

mechanism: Only promising frozen candidates consume a previously untouched audit block.
Run the paired anytime-valid e-process only inside that fresh block.
Allocate a predictable summable global error budget over confirmation attempts, not necessarily over every proposal.
Expose only a minimal constant-shape decision/certificate back to the proposer; keep audit item details and internal evidence trajectory out of future proposal context.
fresh_audit_confirmation_firewall.scope: Generic worker-local architecture. The spending example is not claimed to be SGM's exact schedule.

information_budgeted_reuse_route.principle: When fresh audit data are scarce, restrict every validation-dependent message available to the proposer and pay an explicit transcript/description-length generalization penalty rather than treating raw reused-dev evidence as fresh.
information_budgeted_reuse_route.one_bit_ladder: Bertran/Roth/Wu prove simultaneous bounds for a pre-specified low-information ladder transcript. The guarantee applies to its declared transcript class and decoder assumptions; it is not a drop-in proof that PACE's conditional sign null survives arbitrary reuse.
information_budgeted_reuse_route.side_channel_rule: Any validation-dependent e-wealth, per-item outcome, score, stop time, batch count, latency, cost, exception shape, or other observable metadata is part of the transcript unless hidden/padded or explicitly included in the information bound.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Separate adaptive proposal search from commit certification: frozen candidates receive one-time fresh paired audit streams, within-candidate PACE-style e-testing, and summable confirmation-level risk spending.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Analytic conditional-e-process logic plus the worker-local reused-dev counterexample; supported structurally by adaptive-data-analysis theory and contemporary self-evolution systems that reserve sealed/held-out measurement.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope_guard: Requires genuinely fresh/nonleaking confirmation observations or an equivalent separately proved conditional-null guarantee. Does not itself provide power/sample-size optimality.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: If validation reuse is unavoidable, mediate all validation-dependent feedback through a predeclared low-information transcript and correct generalization for transcript complexity; do not expose raw evidence trajectories.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Description-length/reusable-holdout theory, including 2026 one-bit ladder results for research agents.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope_guard: Not yet an anytime-valid paired commit certificate for arbitrary self-evolution loops. Exact conversion from transcript complexity to sequential sign-e validity remains open.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Audit every self-modification gate on two orthogonal dimensions: candidate-level data/adaptivity validity and run-level multiplicity/cumulative risk.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: PACE supplies a per-candidate optional-stopping guarantee under a conditional sign null; SGM-style methods supply cumulative error budgeting under their own stable/i.i.d. harness assumptions. Neither dimension substitutes for the other.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope_guard: Classification/design principle, not a standalone statistical test.

measurement_validity_rules.rule_1: Optional-stopping validity cannot repair adaptive reuse if the candidate was generated using the same evaluation pool and the conditional sign null is no longer true.
measurement_validity_rules.rule_2: Before multiplying paired e-factors, state and justify the exact filtration-level conditional null for the frozen candidate.
measurement_validity_rules.rule_3: Separate data-leakage/adaptive-selection validity from across-round FWER/FDR or cumulative-risk control.
measurement_validity_rules.rule_4: Claims based on one-bit/low-information validation reuse must count every validation-dependent observable side channel, including stop time and evidence-shape metadata.
measurement_validity_rules.rule_5: A sealed test scored once is strong terminal measurement, but by itself does not validate statistics used repeatedly on the search/dev set.
measurement_validity_rules.rule_6: When reporting a self-evolution certificate, state whether it guarantees one candidate, all confirmations in a run, or only terminal generalization.

rejected_overgeneralizations: PACE's per-candidate theorem automatically covers candidates adaptively generated from the same reused dev set.
Across-round alpha spending repairs a candidate-level test whose data-validity assumptions were already violated.
A one-bit ladder/description-length theorem automatically makes an arbitrary PACE-style adaptive commit loop valid.
Good sealed-test retention proves the repeatedly reused train/dev gate was itself statistically calibrated.
Hiding raw examples while exposing evidence wealth, stop time, detailed scores, or other validation-dependent metadata is still a one-bit channel.
